description: Source file for media transcoding utilities, defining constants, format copying functions, and HDR detection logic within the Android media framework.

classes.name: AMediaFormatUtils
classes.description: Namespace containing utility functions for media format handling, including copying format entries, setting default values, and HDR detection.

methods.name: CopyFormatEntryString
methods.description: Copies a string format entry from one AMediaFormat to another.

methods.name: CopyFormatEntryInt64
methods.description: Copies an int64 format entry from one AMediaFormat to another.

methods.name: CopyFormatEntryInt32
methods.description: Copies an int32 format entry from one AMediaFormat to another.

methods.name: CopyFormatEntryFloat
methods.description: Copies a float format entry from one AMediaFormat to another.

methods.name: CopyFormatEntries
methods.description: Copies multiple format entries based on provided EntryCopier objects.

methods.name: SetDefaultFormatValueFloat
methods.description: Sets a default float value for a format key if not already set.

methods.name: SetDefaultFormatValueInt32
methods.description: Sets a default int32 value for a format key if not already set.

methods.name: VideoIsHdr
methods.description: Determines if a media format describes HDR video content based on format properties.
